description: PPRN – Couches réglementaires du R111.3 de la commune de SAINT-NICOLAS-DE-PORT (54483) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.geo-ide.application.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Pursuant to Article R.111-3 of the Urban Planning Code, these layers delimit the risk of subsidisation due to the dissolution of salt. Article R.111-3, approved by Prefectural Order of 19/03/1991, is PPR under Article L562-6 of the Environmental Code. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "PPRN — Regulatory layers of R111.3 of the municipality of SAINT-NICOLAS-DE-PORT (54483)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include pprn, salifère, ddt54, sel, saint-nicolas-de-port, données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
